import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
l = int(input[1])
r = int(input[2])
a = list(map(int, input[3:3+n]))
p = list(map(int, input[3+n:]))

c = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x: p[x])
b = [a[i] + c[i] for i in range(n)]

if any(x < l or x > r for x in b):
    print(-1)
else:
    print(*b)
